note: Hand-labelled gold. `gold.conditions` are the numeric conditions a correct plan applies to ONE transition record (relative thresholds on the existing <metric>_pct_change field in percent units; directions on <metric>_delta). The oracle recomputes matches from the store's raw metric values (qch.query.metrics.unified_metrics) and edges, independently of the Query Engine operators. `turns` are the user's clarification replies (presentation labels or free text); `first` is what the FIRST response must be when a clarification is expected. Zero-baseline relative deltas do not occur on real transitions with both endpoints; they are covered by unit tests.
